t.E1201.agn: In 2020 EFSA found no genotoxicity concern, stated that no carcinogenic effect was reported at the highest dose tested in rats, and concluded that there was no need for a numerical acceptable daily intake (ADI) and no safety concern at the reported uses.
t.E1201.body: Polyvinylpyrrolidone is very poorly absorbed; most of the amount ingested is excreted in faeces, and the small amount absorbed is excreted by the kidneys.
t.E1201.found.0: Food supplements in tablet and coated tablet form
t.E1201.prod: A polymer produced by polymerising N-vinyl-2-pyrrolidone in water.
t.E1201.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no numerical ADI needed, no safety concern at the reported uses.
t.E1201.summary: A synthetic polymer (PVP). It is used as a binder in supplement tablets.
t.E1201.what: A water-soluble synthetic polymer used in food supplements in tablet form and in sweetener tablets.
